name: Mamre
overview: Mamre is a significant location near Hebron where Abraham settled, built an altar to the LORD, and experienced divine visitation, as God appeared to him there and promised the birth of a son. It was also the dwelling place of Isaac and a city associated with the patriarchs' sojourning. Additionally, Mamre was the name of an Amorite confederate allied with Abraham, highlighting the relationships Abraham maintained with local inhabitants. These passages emphasize Mamre as both a geographical and relational landmark in the unfolding covenantal history.
